scope: Three bounded shared-model requester and catalog regressions
redEvidence: Observed in tool output only; no red-log files were retained for these regressions.

bugs.scenario: A local model proves an initial quota refusal. The ranked chooser validates a remote source. That source goes offline, is revoked, or fails validation before transferToHost revalidates it and before any durable hosted receipt is seeded.
bugs.wrongResult: offer rejects through the detached dispatch catch handler instead of returning a safe refusal. Normal handoff release, failure reporting, idle cleanup and queue draining are skipped. No hosted receipt exists to reconcile this pre-seed failure.
bugs.fix: Catch only the validation rejection before durable seed and return false. A failed acknowledgement after offerExisting remains potentially accepted and retains its durable receipt and true result.

red.cases: Pre-seed validation rejected unexpectedly; unknown-offer acknowledgement control already retained ownership.

bugs.boundary: Actual createSharedAgents, coordinator, chooser and lease with mocked cloud transport; no production or real provider calls.

bugs.scenario: A client-scope member who cannot see a restricted bot supplies its known ID to GET /api/origin/model-host/catalog?botId=restricted. The server owner still has Origin access to that bot's project.
bugs.wrongResult: The query-only bot ID bypasses pathSubject visibility gating. The route calls the owner-scoped catalog and returns host owner, computer and model availability metadata. The member response filter does not remove sources arrays.
bugs.fix: Check the current caller's VisibleSet before querying catalog and return the ordinary no-such-bot 404 for invisible IDs. Pass visibility through the controller with a fail-closed default. Preserve admin-only source settings and revocation.

red.cases: Restricted and unknown member IDs were accepted; visible-member and existing admin controls passed.

bugs.boundary: Actual route and VisibleSet with synthetic request/session and catalog fixtures. No production catalog or account data was queried.

bugs.scenario: A shared request is displayed as working while a teammate's model runs. After a safe initial quota refusal, backend advance and the exact sender lease succeed, but the stored task still carries the hosted working/busy presentation flag when the local sender is started.
bugs.wrongResult: The local sender callback receives a working task; the real startTurn busy check can refuse before native dispatch. Without a separate physical-run check, the callback is also invoked when a local turn is already running.
bugs.fix: After the current-request and exact lease checks, refuse if locallyRunning is true. Otherwise clear only the hosted presentation activity to idle immediately before calling startHostedSender. Preserve the physical-run activity.

red.cases: Callback observed working instead of idle; physical-running control incorrectly reached the callback.

bugs.boundary: The manager/coordinator/lease regression uses mocked canonical cloud responses. Subsequent retained acceptance uses two isolated native servers and repository fake providers; it proves one remote quota attempt followed by one successful local sender attempt with an inherited working folder, one canonical user/reply pair and visibility on both clients. It does not prove a real provider CLI sandbox or production execution.

limitations: Two isolated native servers and repository fake providers only
Aliases model distinct synthetic accounts on one owner computer
No production, real provider, email or GitHub calls
No packaged UI, real CLI sandbox or positive metered API acceptance

verification.lint: Touched requester/controller/route files and new regressions passed oxlint --deny-warnings.
verification.nativeAcceptanceScope: Two isolated native servers and repository fake providers only

withdrawnFinding: A proposed stale-generation cleanup scenario was not reproduced: two isolated fixture attempts could not start the assumed replacement while the old quota probe kept busy set. The unsupported test was removed; no index cleanup fence was applied or claimed as a proved fix.
